edges.reason: stakingContract_ parameter is assigned to the stakingContract state variable.
msg.sender must equal initializer to authorize the one-shot initialization.
_INDEX parameter is converted to gons and stored in INDEX.
onlyManager modifier gates setIndex on msg.sender == _owner.
_owner value determines whether the onlyManager check on setIndex passes.
profit_ parameter flows into the rebase calculation.
epoch_ parameter flows into events and _storeRebase.
rebaseAmount is added to _totalSupply inside rebase.
circulatingSupply_ is the divisor in the rebase proportion calculation.
circulatingSupply() result is cached into the local circulatingSupply_.
rebase writes the expanded _totalSupply state variable.
rebase recomputes _gonsPerFragment from the new total supply.
rebase performs mul/div/add arithmetic subject to overflow and divide-by-zero.
rebase calls _storeRebase to persist rebase metadata.
profit_ is forwarded into _storeRebase for the stored rebase record.
epoch_ is forwarded into _storeRebase and emitted.
rebasePercent computed from profit_ and previous supply is stored in rebases.
_storeRebase pushes a new Rebase struct into the rebases array.
block.timestamp is embedded in the LogSupply event emitted by _storeRebase.
index() result is stored inside the Rebase struct.
destination address parameter is credited in transfer.
value parameter is converted to gons and moved in transfer.
msg.sender balance is debited in transfer without any allowance check.
transfer performs gon sub/add arithmetic on balances.
transfer mutates both sender and recipient entries of _gonBalances.
gonValue local derived from value * _gonsPerFragment drives balance updates.
from parameter selects the allowance and balance to debit.
to parameter receives the transferred gons.
value parameter is subtracted from allowance and converted to gons.
msg.sender allowance entry is used as the spender in transferFrom.
transferFrom writes the reduced _allowedValue entry.
transferFrom debits and credits _gonBalances entries.
transferFrom performs gon balance sub/add arithmetic.
spender parameter receives the allowance in approve.
value parameter is written as the allowance amount.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
approve directly writes _allowedValue[msg.sender][spender].
owner parameter is hashed and compared to the recovered signer.
spender parameter is hashed and later granted allowance.
amount parameter is hashed and later granted as allowance.
deadline parameter is hashed and compared to block.timestamp.
permit requires block.timestamp <= deadline, a miner-influenced timestamp check.
recovered signer must be non-zero and equal owner to authorize the allowance.
permit delegates the allowance update to _approve.
permit reads and increments the owner nonce in _nonces.
permit uses DOMAIN_SEPARATOR when rebuilding the signed digest.
_approve writes the _allowedValue mapping entry.
renounceManagement is gated by the onlyManager msg.sender check.
pushManagement is gated by the onlyManager msg.sender check.
newOwner_ parameter is assigned to _newOwner.
pushManagement stores the pending owner in _newOwner.
pullManagement requires msg.sender == _newOwner.
_newOwner is read to validate and then becomes the new _owner.
pullManagement transfers ownership by writing _owner.
manager() returns the _owner state variable.
recipient parameter is the target of the raw value transfer.
amount parameter is the wei value forwarded in the call.
sendValue performs an external call forwarding all gas to an untrusted recipient.
_functionCallWithValue performs an external call with value and arbitrary calldata.
functionDelegateCall executes untrusted target code via delegatecall in this context.
balanceOf reads _gonBalances[who].
balanceOf divides by _gonsPerFragment, a divide-by-zero risk if it is zero.
gonsForBalance multiplies by _gonsPerFragment.
balanceForGons divides by _gonsPerFragment, a divide-by-zero risk.
circulatingSupply reads _totalSupply before subtracting the staking balance.
circulatingSupply calls balanceOf(stakingContract).
index() reads the INDEX state variable.
index() converts INDEX through balanceForGons.
increaseAllowance adds to and writes the _allowedValue entry.
msg.sender selects whose allowance entry is increased.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from and writes the _allowedValue entry.
msg.sender selects whose allowance entry is decreased.
spender parameter selects the allowance entry in increaseAllowance.
addedValue is added to the current allowance.
spender parameter selects the allowance entry in decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is compared and subtracted from the current allowance.
initialize writes the privileged stakingContract address exactly once.
initialize grants the full TOTAL_GONS balance to the staking contract.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter is only consumed by initialize when assigning stakingContract.
Parameter is only consumed by setIndex when re-denominating INDEX.
profit_ is used solely inside rebase and its _storeRebase call.
epoch_ is used solely inside rebase and its _storeRebase call.
Recipient parameter only feeds the transfer balance update.
Value parameter only feeds the transfer gon conversion.
Source parameter only feeds the transferFrom allowance and balance updates.
Destination parameter only feeds the transferFrom balance credit.
Value parameter only feeds the transferFrom allowance and gon arithmetic.
Spender parameter only feeds the approve allowance write.
Value parameter only feeds the approve allowance write.
Spender parameter selects the allowance entry inside increaseAllowance.
addedValue is only used in the increaseAllowance arithmetic.
Spender parameter selects the allowance entry inside decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is only used in the decreaseAllowance arithmetic.
owner parameter is only used for permit signature verification and approval.
spender parameter is only used within the permit digest and approval.
amount parameter is only used within the permit digest and approval.
deadline parameter is only used in the permit expiry check.
newOwner_ is only consumed when writing _newOwner in pushManagement.
recipient parameter is only used as the low-level call target.
amount parameter is only used as the low-level call value.
rebaseAmount is a temporary result of the rebase arithmetic before being applied.
circulatingSupply_ is a cached read of circulatingSupply used as the rebase divisor.
gonValue is the intermediate multiplication result used in the transfer arithmetic.
rebasePercent is computed and immediately stored in the Rebase struct.
signer is the ecrecover result compared against owner inside permit.
